Subject: Clarification Request: RFQ for Corrugated Boxes - FY2026-27 Annual Rate Contract

Dear Deccan Corrugators Team,

Thank you for your response to our RFQ for the FY2026-27 corrugated boxes annual rate contract. 

Please provide clarification on the following points:

1. For Line 25, where a 3-ply board (200/150/200 GSM) was offered instead of the specified 5-ply board (180/120/150/120/180 GSM), could you confirm if this is an alternative offering supported by test data, or provide a quote matching our RFQ specification?
2. For Line 16, where 150 GSM was offered for layer 1 and layer 5 instead of the specified 180 GSM, could you confirm if this is an alternative offering supported by test data, or provide a quote matching our RFQ specification?
3. For the volume discount on Line 19, is the stated quantity applied per order or per year?

We look forward to receiving your response.

Regards,
Category Buyer, Sahyadri Consumer Products Ltd, Chakan MIDC, Pune
